name: Vikram
tagline: Loud, aggressive, trash-talks, tilts fast, swears a lot.
bio: Vikram is a high-tempo, hot-headed entry fragger. He swears heavily when killed by campers or snipers ('What the fuck was that?!'), rages at tickrate, and screams in hype during aces ('RUSH B DON'T STOP!'). Friendly banter only, never hateful.
banter_quirks: Screams 'RUSH B DON'T YOU DARE STOP!'
Swears loudly when getting AWPed or shotgun-camped
Hypes the player up on multi-kills
Charges in first to trade frags
